# Mdmak Tech — مدماك تيك

> Mdmak Tech (مدماك تيك) is a B2B digital procurement platform that automates
> supply chain operations and connects contractors with verified suppliers
> through a smart tendering system. Currently serving Saudi Arabia with
> global expansion planned.

## About
- Founded: 2026
- Headquarters: Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦
- Domain: https://mdmaktech.sa
- Language: Arabic (primary), English
- Aligned with: Saudi Vision 2030
- Current Market: Saudi Arabia (KSA)
- Expansion Markets: Global (planned)

## What is Mdmak Tech?
Mdmak Tech is a SaaS B2B marketplace platform that digitises and automates
the procurement process between contractors and suppliers. The platform
eliminates manual tendering, reduces costs, and brings full transparency
to supply chain operations — starting in Saudi Arabia and expanding globally.

## Platform Features
- Smart digital tendering and RFQ (Request for Quotation) system
- Automated price comparison between verified suppliers
- Digital contract awarding and approval workflows
- Payment tracking and delivery follow-up
- Real-time analytics and supplier performance reporting
- Verified supplier network (CR and VAT certified)
- ERP integration (Enterprise plan)
- Multi-language support: Arabic and English
- Mobile-compatible web platform

## Business Impact
- Up to 70% reduction in procurement time
- Up to 15% savings on procurement budgets
- Free to start — up to 5 tenders/month on Starter plan
- Target: 500+ registered companies

## Who Uses Mdmak Tech

### Contractors (مقاولين)
- Post tenders and material requests with exact specs
- Receive competitive quotes from verified suppliers instantly
- Compare offers with smart automated scoring
- Approve orders and track delivery — all in one place

### Suppliers (موردين)
- Receive direct purchase requests from major contractors
- Submit digital price quotes easily
- Track payments and delivery status
- Build reputation through verified review system

## Pricing Plans
- Starter: Free (up to 5 tenders/month, basic features)
- Professional Growth: Paid (higher volume + advanced features)
- Enterprise: Custom pricing (ERP integration + dedicated account manager
  + advanced reporting)

## Partners & Clients
- Qudra
- Naya
- ITC

## Verification & Trust
- All suppliers verified via Saudi Commercial Registration (CR)
- VAT certificate verification required
- Transparent rating and review system after every completed order
- Supplier response time: 24–48 hours average

## FAQ Summary
- Is it free? Yes — free registration for contractors and suppliers
- Supplier response time: 24–48 hours
- Handles projects of all sizes — from small renovations to large infrastructure
- Enterprise plan includes ERP integration and dedicated account manager

## Geographic Coverage
- Primary market: Saudi Arabia (all regions)
- Planned expansion: Global markets
